name: soundwave-visualizer-bar
title: Soundwave Visualizer Bar
description: An audio equalizer bar array pulsating with organic harmonic frequency fluctuations and vertical dancing springs.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Pill
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Monospace
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Continuous Frequency Bounce: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
